spec.title: Back up, switch, restart
spec.scope: Three exclusive states model a release. Prepared means a verified backup, and Switched means the configuration is committed. Restart leaves the tracked configuration state unchanged.

operations.name: Back up
operations.rule: From Closed, go to Prepared. From Prepared, stay Prepared. From Switched, stay Switched.

operations.name: Switch config
operations.rule: From Closed, explicitly BLOCKED. From Prepared, go to Switched. From Switched, stay Switched.

operations.name: Restart
operations.rule: From Closed, explicitly BLOCKED. From Prepared, explicitly BLOCKED. From Switched, stay Switched.

spec.title: Conflicting cache policies
spec.scope: Only two cache policy modes are relevant to this abstract release. The recorded terminal mode determines whether the deployment would end in Cold or Warm.

operations.name: Disable warming
operations.rule: From Cold, stay Cold. From Warm, go to Cold.

operations.name: Enable warming
operations.rule: From Cold, go to Warm. From Warm, stay Warm.

operations.name: Record preference
operations.rule: From Cold, stay Cold. From Warm, stay Warm.

spec.title: Stable logging rollout
spec.scope: This model projects a logging rollout onto two observable modes. A metrics check and a documentation receipt each leave the projected mode unchanged.

operations.name: Enable logging
operations.rule: From Off, go to On. From On, stay On.

operations.name: Check metrics
operations.rule: From Off, stay Off. From On, stay On.

operations.name: Record documentation
operations.rule: From Off, stay Off. From On, stay On.

spec.title: A missing restore rule
spec.scope: Only two modes are relevant. Missing rules are unspecified and should be reviewed. This scenario intentionally omits Restore behavior from Parked.

operations.name: Park
operations.rule: From Ready, go to Parked. From Parked, stay Parked.

operations.name: Restore
operations.rule: From Ready, stay Ready. Parked has no specified transition.

operations.name: Inspect
operations.rule: From Ready, stay Ready. From Parked, stay Parked.

spec.title: Disabled release checkpoint
spec.scope: This release is gated at every possible start. Audit and documentation can run, but neither grants the missing release authorization.

operations.name: Release checkpoint
operations.rule: From Queued, explicitly BLOCKED. From Staged, explicitly BLOCKED.

operations.name: Audit
operations.rule: From Queued, stay Queued. From Staged, stay Staged.

operations.name: Document
operations.rule: From Queued, stay Queued. From Staged, stay Staged.
